peerMapping.justification: The block uses only CORE_UNIVERSE symbols and excludes PLTR from the peer sleeve. Peer weights are positive and sum to exactly 1: comparability is led by Microsoft and Alphabet, supported by Meta Platforms, while NVIDIA, Advanced Micro Devices, and Nebius Group add AI compute and infrastructure exposure at lower weights. The liquidity check uses the displayed 24-hour perp liquidity in USD millions, not market capitalization or share volume; every selected peer is deeper than Palantir's 0.544 USD millions, so the sleeve avoids leaning on books thinner than the target while retaining single-name equity specificity. The sole primary index hedge is XYZ100, and commodity rows and other ETF rows were not used.

peers.name: Microsoft
peers.reason: Microsoft is the closest large-scale software and enterprise AI comparator in CORE_UNIVERSE; its displayed 24-hour perp liquidity is 1.386 USD millions, deeper than Palantir's 0.544 USD millions, so it can carry the largest peer weight.

peers.name: Alphabet
peers.reason: Alphabet adds data, applied AI model, and cloud software exposure with displayed 24-hour perp liquidity of 2.262 USD millions, making it a high-comparability and deeper-liquidity peer.

peers.name: NVIDIA
peers.reason: NVIDIA is the primary AI compute equity and effectively sets the AI factor that PLTR's software story trades against, giving it the highest economic comparability in the block. Its displayed 24-hour perp liquidity is 3.384 USD millions, which supports the largest peer weight.

peers.name: Meta Platforms
peers.reason: Meta Platforms is not a pure enterprise software match, but its AI model spending and data-driven platform make it a useful high-beta technology peer; displayed 24-hour perp liquidity is 1.343 USD millions.

peers.name: Nebius Group
peers.reason: Nebius Group provides AI cloud infrastructure, so it captures the infrastructure side of Palantir's AI theme with displayed 24-hour perp liquidity of 2.35 USD millions; because it is less like Palantir's software business, it gets the smallest positive peer weight.

peers.name: Advanced Micro Devices
peers.reason: Advanced Micro Devices is a second AI compute supplier that diversifies the semiconductor factor in the block while keeping positive sensitivity to AI capital spending; displayed 24-hour perp liquidity is 1.18 USD millions.

primary_index_hedge.name: Nasdaq-100
primary_index_hedge.reason: XYZ100 is an equity_index row with displayed 24-hour perp liquidity of 21.944 USD millions. It hedges the Nasdaq-listed high-growth AI and software factor that dominates Palantir more directly than the broader SP500, while still being much deeper than Palantir's 0.544 USD millions.

peerMapping.historyMethod: daily-rebalanced peer spot total returns using the fixed Kimi weights; unavailable pre-listing peers are omitted and remaining weights renormalized once at least three peers exist; basket rebased to the target spot level at the first overlapping date

liveSplice.method: current TradeXYZ perp mid divided by each peer's latest USD cash close; available Kimi weights renormalized and applied as a one-period return from the published peer spot close

earningsOptions.source: Schwab listed-options chain, FMP earnings calendars, and Sharadar adjusted prices

liquidityFilter.sides: OTM puts below spot and OTM calls above spot

model.name: liquid vertical-spread risk-neutral CDF
model.description: Liquid vertical spreads are used when the chain supplies at least four valid probability points; otherwise the nearest liquid ATM straddle supplies the expiration distribution. Earnings-date log distances are time-scaled from the first post-event expiration.
model.measure: risk-neutral, not a historical or physical forecast

historicalAnalysis.eventSource: SEC earnings release history with FMP historical calendar fallback
historicalAnalysis.method: Each current two-leg structure is translated into percentage-of-spot strikes and debit. Those same normalized strikes and today's debit percentage are replayed across prior earnings using the same calendar-day entry lead and post-event exit horizon. A profitable event requires expiration payoff greater than the original debit.
historicalAnalysis.limitation: Stock-path proxy using today's premium; historical option quotes, bid-ask execution, volatility repricing, early exercise, dividends, and transaction costs are not reconstructed.
